newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian bullion trimmed at close on world setback.
newsitem.headline: Indian bullion trimmed at close on world setback.

text.p: Gold and silver opened higher on the back of limited arrivals but reports of a setback in world markets triggered profit-taking at the improved level, trimming early gains towards the close, dealers said.
"Bullion prices in the world market during the second half of last week remained firm but firmness petered out today," one dealer added.
In the local market physical buying was at a low ebb and only speculative enquiries fuelled trading sentiment.
On Saturday gold was up by 40 rupees per 10 grammes while silver was up by 45 rupees per kg.
